mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT CMPNY_CD , CMPNY_NM FROM ( SELECT BASE.CMPNY_CD , B.CMPNY_NM FROM ( SELECT A.CMPNY_CD FROM CM_AUTHOR_USER A INNER JOIN CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH B ON B.MBRSH_SQ = A.USER_CD AND B.USER_ID = #{loginUserId} WHERE A.AUTHOR_CD = 'AUTH_ADMIN' AND A.USER_TY = 'USER' UNION SELECT A.CMPNY_CD FROM CM_AUTHOR_USER A INNER JOIN CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH B ON B.MBRSH_SQ IN (SELECT MBRSH_SQ FROM CM_GROUP_USER WHERE CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND GROUP_ID = A.USER_CD) AND B.USER_ID = #{loginUserId} WHERE A.AUTHOR_CD = 'AUTH_ADMIN' AND A.USER_TY = 'GROUP' UNION SELECT A.CMPNY_CD FROM CM_AUTHOR_USER A INNER JOIN CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH B ON B.MBRSH_SQ = A.USER_CD AND B.USER_ID = #{loginUserId} WHERE A.AUTHOR_CD = 'SYS_ADMIN' AND A.USER_TY = 'USER' UNION SELECT A.CMPNY_CD FROM CM_AUTHOR_USER A INNER JOIN CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH B ON B.MBRSH_SQ IN (SELECT MBRSH_SQ FROM CM_GROUP_USER WHERE CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND GROUP_ID = A.USER_CD) AND B.USER_ID = #{loginUserId} WHERE A.AUTHOR_CD = 'SYS_ADMIN' AND A.USER_TY = 'GROUP' ) BASE INNER JOIN CM_CMPNY B ON B.CMPNY_CD = BASE.CMPNY_CD AND B.USE_FL = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT A.CMPNY_CD , B.CMPNY_NM FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH A INNER JOIN CM_USER U ON U.USER_ID = A.USER_ID INNER JOIN CM_CMPNY B ON B.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND B.USE_FL = 'Y' WHERE A.USER_ID = #{loginUserId} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' AND A.RETIRE_YMD > DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d') ) A

SELECT A.DETAIL_CODE_VALUE AS code , B.MESSAGE_CN AS name FROM CM_CODE_DETAIL A INNER JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG B ON B.LANG_KEY = A.CODE_LANG_KEY AND B.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD WHERE A.CODE_ID = 'CMMNCODE.100' AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{companyCode} AND B.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' ORDER BY A.SORTING_SQ ASC

SELECT A.DETAIL_CODE_ID AS code , B.MESSAGE_CN AS name FROM CM_CODE_DETAIL A INNER JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG B ON B.LANG_KEY = A.CODE_LANG_KEY AND B.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD WHERE A.CODE_ID = 'CMMNCODE.200' AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{companyCode} AND B.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' ORDER BY A.SORTING_SQ ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CM_MESSAGE_LANG ( CMPNY_CD, LANG_GB, LANG_KEY, LANG_CODE, MESSAGE_CN, CREATION_ID, CREATION_DT ) VALUES ( #{cmpnyCd}, #{langGb}, #{langKey}, #{langCode}, #{messageCn}, #{creationId}, NOW() )
